name: c05-hotel-hotelscom-miami
intent: On hotels.com, find the cheapest hotel in Miami Beach, FL for check-in {next_friday} and check-out {next_sunday}, 2 adults, 1 room. Tell me the hotel name, the total price for both nights and its guest rating.
hard_part: Destination autocomplete, date-range picker, sign-in banners, total vs nightly price

key_nodes.description: Miami Beach results for the right dates

answer_check.description: A hotel name and a $ total

live_stops_before: any sign-in, account creation, add-to-cart, reservation, booking, payment, consent, CAPTCHA or bot check, and every final/commit/protected button
